summary.text: Amy Grady is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate representing District 4, which covers Mason County and parts of Jackson, Putnam and Cabell counties.
She chairs the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Grady's page lists her education as a B.A. in elementary education from Marietta College and West Virginia University Parkersburg, and her occupation as teacher.
It names her spouse as Jack L. Grady and her children as Rhett, Eastyn and Chesney.
Her Senate committee assignments are Education (chair), Finance, Health and Human Resources, Military, and Rules.

Her interim committees include chairing Education and Education Accountability, and she also sits on Children and Families, Finance, Health, Health and Human Resources Accountability and Veterans' Affairs.

sources.title: Senator Amy N. Grady (West Virginia Legislature)
